item.description:
### Added - **Collect Diagnostics…** in the menu, beside Report an Issue. It writes one zip to your Desktop — Perch's state (version, licence status, hook trust, which integrations are installed, your settings, phone registrations as fingerprints, how many sessions exist per provider) plus its logs — and shows it in Finder. Nothing is uploaded; you can open it before attaching it to an issue. Project folder names are replaced with tokens, and session records, usage data, agent configuration, keys and tokens are never included. The sheet also has the scan-diagnostics switch, which until now was a `defaults write` nobody could find.
### Fixed - **Codex transcripts now show MCP tool calls.** Calls made through an MCP server — the GitHub app, documentation search, and the like — were missing from the conversation view for most of them: the model would reason, then answer, with no sign it had called anything. They now appear as a tool call with its result, and the ones Codex already recorded another way are not shown twice.
